card.name: Small words in war-crimes and genocide text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, quote marks or digits (and, of, a, before, 9) in passages about war crimes, genocide, the Holocaust and tribunals. The word comes just before a term like genocide or crimes.

modes.label: After crimes against humanity
modes.description: A linking word or opening quote right after the phrase crimes against humanity.
modes.example: with crimes against humanity<< and>> subsequently charged four other senior officials

modes.label: Dates in atrocity history
modes.description: The digit 9 in a year such as 1990s or 1947 in text about wars and trials.
modes.example: during the Yugoslav wars of the 1<<9>>90s

modes.label: Tribunal and camp wording
modes.description: Small words inside phrases about Nuremberg trials, war crimes or extermination camps.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like genocide, atrocities and crimes as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in text about genocide and war crimes, where a term like genocide is likely to come next.
